items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Rabbit was owned by Quine... [INTERVIEWEE] Several of them called Georgia. No, it wasn't Georgia Minstrel.

ctx.x: He's playing minstrel. He was on the minstrel.

What's the name of that minstrel he was on? Old Man Quine show. It wasn't a rabbit foot. What was the other one? Old Man Quine show. What's the other show? Rabbit was owned by Quine. They had the rabbit foot and they had another show. I just remember. I just remember. I just remember. Oh, it was on a show. It wasn't a rabbit foot. It's, uh, it's operated by the same people. Oh, I used to kid all the time about that show. I can't think of it. But anyhow, he traveled minstrel shows.
Several of them called Georgia. No, it wasn't Georgia Minstrel.
